text:
maya: Quick design sync — thinking about adding saved filter presets to the Roles matrix. Idea: admins can save combinations (role type + status + team) and see an SSO rollover hint when switching org contexts. Thoughts?
jonathan: Love saved presets. big Q: where does the preset dropdown live? top toolbar or inside the filter panel?
tess: top toolbar keeps filters discoverable for heavy users. inside panel is more discoverable for newbies. maybe both? :thinking:
maya: Right. Proposal: small chevron next to Filters in toolbar opens a compact menu: Recent presets + Save current filters. When inside filter panel we surface a "Manage presets" link that opens the same modal.
samir: UX nit: keyboard access. If presets live in the toolbar, ensure it's reachable with Meta+/. Also the active preset should be announced to screen readers. ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: focus order, aria-expanded, aria-live for preset changes.
jonathan: Implementation question: presets are org-scoped. But SSO rollover case: when someone toggles from Org A to Org B that uses a different SSO config, we currently keep the same preset filter which may reference teams that don't exist. We should show a transient banner: "This preset may not apply to Org B — preview and apply" with a fallback to default all-roles.
tess: I like "preview and apply" — avoids surprise. Also add a small badge on the preset name if teams referenced are missing: ex. "Marketing (partial)"
maya: Copy suggestion for banner: "This saved filter includes teams not present in this organization. Preview results before applying." Shorter variant for small screens: "Some teams are unavailable in this org — preview?"
samir: For keyboard users the preview should be inline, not a modal. Modal traps focus which is annoying when quickly switching orgs. Inline toast with a focusable "Preview" button + link to manage presets.
jonathan: Technical: store presets as meta per org id; for cross-org portability we could include team slugs and map to local teams on apply, falling back if unmatched. We should audit how many presets reference cross-org teams before building migration.
tess: Design detail: in the roles matrix, when a preset is active highlight changed columns briefly (0.5s) to show what's different — animation must be subtle; motion reduced variant for users who prefer reduced motion. ux-bot: Motion preference detected via prefers-reduced-motion, don't animate.
maya: One more: audit log integration. If a user arrives from an audit log entry ("changed role X"), we should surface a small inline CTA "Open in Roles matrix with filters" that applies a one-off preset (not saved) and highlights the changed row. This helps context switching.
jonathan: Agreed. For the one-off preset we add query params like ?preset_temp=1&highlight=user:123. Keep it ephemeral in URL so bookmarks don't persist.
samir: Accessibility for that highlight: use aria-describedby on the row to announce "Highlighted due to audit action" and ensure focus lands on it for keyboard users.
tess: Copy proposal for the CTA: "View in Roles matrix" with a tooltip: "Opens the Roles matrix with filters from this audit entry"
maya: Action items: 1) design mockup for toolbar dropdown + in-panel manage link (tess) 2) copy variants for banner and CTA (maya) 3) dev spike to count cross-org team references in presets (jonathan) 4) accessibility checklist items (samir) 5) small anim spec + reduced-motion fallback (tess).
jonathan: I'll run the spike and post numbers by EOD Friday.
tess: Mockups by Thursday morning.
samir: I'll draft the aria spec and keyboard shortcuts doc.
maya: Thanks all — will follow up in PR with mockups and copy. :thumbsup:
